text.title: Heartland March
text.body: With the evacuation fleet safely beyond the Western Rim, the rearguard climbs the freezing granite spine to Highcrest Citadel. Rearm at Elda's meteoric forge, sweep Iron Pact forward scouts from the ash-draped pine trail, and shatter the gorge ambush sealing the Northern Pass.
text.obj.0: Clear Iron Pact forward scouts from the ash-draped trail
text.obj.1: Break the gorge ambush and seize the Northern Pass
text.msg.1: The civilians are safe beyond the horizon; fear has nothing left to hold over us. Marshal Veyra's coastal veterans stand sharp beside our mountain guard—sweep the trail and force the Northern Pass!
text.msg.2: The forward scout screen shatters; abandoned in the gray cinder-snow lies a border coffer of four hundred silver florins.
text.msg.3: Watch the granite switchbacks—Iron Pact ambushers are dropping from the gorge walls!
text.msg.4: The Northern Pass falls! The road into the volcanic heartland lies open before us.
text.npc.elda: Highcrest's forge tempers Tier 5 meteoric ironplate and armor-sundering halberds built to split obsidian carapaces. Speak with Archivist Orla as well—she carries the pre-calamity inscriptions of the Crown Vault.
text.win: The Northern Pass is seized and the rearguard marches into the Obsidian Caldera.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell on the Heartland March.
